author: xVigilan-Tx
quote:
As a day 1 player of the original OoT I cringed at the thought of the remake, picturing it butchering my fondest memories in gaming, but as a gamer, I took the plunge, and thank whatever deity you believe in I did!

Not only is it better than I originally pictured it as a child but somehow, its better! Its smooth, detailed and incredibly faithful to the original whilst adding quality of life updates to enhance your gameplay, not hinder.

From the jaw dropping soundtrack to the newly envisioned graphics, it is nothing short of a masterpiece! The story is perfect, so needed no changes whatsoever.

It also added some features that allows players to revisit past encounters, adding replayability.

This game is truly worthy of its original 99 given what it done in its era and continues to do now.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: xVigilan-Tx
quote:
A beautiful and expansive game but it feels as if we went backwards in content from GTA5. Things have openly been removed which were staples in the franchise for reasons I wont go into for fear of backlash.

Pacing is slow and gameplay boring it feels more like a SIM game than a GTA. The expected humour and flow from the trinity of Franklin, Micheal and Trevor is looooong gone, replaced with possibly THE WORST voice acting in Jason and Lucia.

The days of picking up a GTA for pure unadulterated fun, doing reckless and crazy things for kicks are gone, now you can rub feet, buy flowers, buy groceries and attend the every whim of your insane terrible girlfriend: in a GTA game!

Truly sad that gamers waited 13 years for a game that barely delivers on what people envisioned, unless of course you're a female new to GTA and gaming, then its perfect.

Hopefully the online can save it some brownie points because the story is shockingly bad, beautiful but bad.... kinda like Lucia.
